evidence: Some of our products, services and processes leverage AI, including both machine learning and generative AI, and we continue to make investments in initiatives focused on the further development and deployment of these technologies.

In October 2025, we launched version 2.0 of our Digital Experience Platform (also referred to as DXP), which offers enhanced content management and smart document processing, an easy-to-use secure platform with workflow tools and Artificial Intelligence agents

Consumer Storage, provides on-demand, valet storage for consumers utilizing data analytics and machine learning to provide effective customer acquisition and a convenient and seamless consumer storage experience.

Our ability to attract and retain customers, particularly in our Global Digital Solutions business, depends on our ability to offer innovative products and services, including through developing or deploying emerging technologies such as AI.
ai_positioning.summary: IRM intègre l'IA et le machine learning dans ses produits et services (DXP 2.0, Consumer Storage, Digital Solutions) tout en reconnaissant les risques réglementaires et opérationnels associés à cette intégration.

governance.voting_structure: Annual election of directors with majority voting standard
